title: Woman Riding Horse, 1940s B&W Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-1940s snapshot capturing a smiling young woman seated comfortably on a western saddle atop a horse in an open field. She is dressed in a short-sleeved striped button-front shirt, casual trousers, and riding boots, with her hair styled in classic 1940s curls. The background features lush trees under a clear sky.
